title: The Ray of Creation — Seven Worlds
lore: Gurdjieff as recorded by P. D. Ouspensky

source.book: P. D. Ouspensky, In Search of the Miraculous, section describing the Ray of Creation and orders of laws
source.notes: The source calls world 6 'All Suns' in a standard table, while also treating one chosen starry world as our Milky Way. Thus the film labels All Suns / one chosen galaxy without claiming all suns everywhere equal the Milky Way.

worlds.label: Earth
worlds.depiction: textured blue-green globe bearing trees, grass and human figures

worlds.label: Moon
worlds.kind: growing end of the selected ray in this account

semantic_operations.source_relation: successive worlds, with one world selected in each nested order
semantic_operations.visual_treatment: one continuous branching gold-white strand passing through seven persistent, differentiated visual worlds; faint side branches indicate other possible selections
semantic_operations.why: Conveys selected lineage without turning it into independent slide cards
semantic_operations.does_not_assert: Literal celestial wiring, astronomical distance, transmission conduit, or physical world creation occurring during the 124-second film

semantic_operations.source_relation: greater numbers of orders of laws accompany greater mechanicalness and reduced independence
semantic_operations.visual_treatment: a recurring motion motif becomes increasingly enclosed within multiple overlapping rhythmic patterns at successively lower worlds; exact source-law counts appear typographically
semantic_operations.why: Differentiate structural degrees of constraint from merely changing the number on screen
semantic_operations.does_not_assert: That there are literally 1/3/6/12/24/48/96 drawn curves, that laws are physical cages, or that any loop is a specific Gurdjieff law

semantic_operations.source_relation: specific distinguishable cosmological scopes and worlds
semantic_operations.visual_treatment: non-personal emblem; galaxy clusters; spiral galaxy; luminous Sun; differentiated planets; living Earth; cratered Moon
semantic_operations.why: Prevents seven anonymous generic circles from substituting for distinct world referents
semantic_operations.does_not_assert: Empirically accurate celestial scale, galaxy count, planetary arrangement or geography

semantic_operations.source_relation: organic life receives planetary influences and mediates them toward Earth
semantic_operations.visual_treatment: recognizable grass, branching vegetation and human figures over the same textured globe used in Experiment 011; small animated source-to-envelope and envelope-to-Earth marks during Earth focus
semantic_operations.why: Connects hierarchical cosmology to the already developed life-mediated relation without making life a generic atmospheric shell
semantic_operations.does_not_assert: Literal particles, identified cosmic influences or conversion rates

semantic_operations.source_relation: viewer selection of a chain of worlds, independent of any one chronology
semantic_operations.visual_treatment: continuous pan and zoom through a persistent world and final zoom out to the whole chosen ray
semantic_operations.why: Separates presentation time from ontological creation time and supports whole/part comprehension
semantic_operations.does_not_assert: The Absolute or all worlds have metric spatial locations along a literal physical ladder

ornament: Atmospheric star dust, nebula colors and luminous scattering provide depth but do not denote additional world levels.
Solar spokes and lunar crater texture are iconographic or decorative, not encoded law types.
Ambient harmonic pads, synthetic bells and small repeated clicks are original sound design, not Gurdjieff's prescribed musical theory.
negative_claims: This film depicts Gurdjieff's teaching, not empirically accepted astrophysics.
The seven numbers represent 'orders of laws' in the source model and are not physical measurements.
The individual constraints and their distinct mechanisms are not enumerated in the film.
Cross-scale spatial proximity is a composition strategy, not astronomy.
No source explicitly associates a particular color, shape, pulse frequency or motion path with a law.
status: provisional artistic rendering; no established transferable visual notation or measured audience comprehension
sound: original synthesized ambient stereo soundtrack, with no spoken narration
subtitles: burned-in source-scoped English captions; a separate SRT is supplied
